scoring_justification: The thermal lens focal length f_th can be recomputed from the paper's analytic expressions (Eqs. 14, 20, 22) using the same coupler parameters. The checker recomputes f_th for each listed input power P and compares to the agent's reported values.

outputs.description: The computed thermal lens focal length for each input laser power from 0 to 2000 W in steps of 100 W.

output_contract.notes: The beam quality analysis (stage 4) is omitted because the resonator parameters (R, L) are not specified in the paper and cannot be reliably reproduced.
